title: Introduce feature flags
description: We want to ship code behind flags and turn features on gradually.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Chose a self-hosted open source flag service because it works offline for local development and avoids a per-seat subscription.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: We rejected plain environment variables because changing one needs a redeploy and gives no audit trail of who turned a feature on.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Gotcha: old flags pile up. Every flag now needs an owner and a removal date in the ticket, otherwise nobody deletes them.
